newsitem.title: UK: Sterling jumps over a pfennig after BoE report.
newsitem.headline: Sterling jumps over a pfennig after BoE report.

text.p: Sterling jumped more than one pfennig and half a cent in Europe after the Bank of England called for a fresh rise in interest rates and warned inflation was likely to overshoot without more policy action.
"The surprise is that they are still calling for another tightening of policy before seeing the effects of the last one," said David Coleman, chief economist at CIBC Wood Gundy.

Only last week rates were hiked to 6.25 percent from 6.0 percent in a bid to keep inflation in check. But in its first report since it was granted the freedom to set rates, the BoE warned inflation was likely to overshoot without policy action.
